data.name: Biztopia: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
This Prologue offers a limited part of the full Biztopia experience. You can start your own business immediately, explore the city, and experience the early stages of your entrepreneurial journey. The Prologue is playable only up to level 10.

What Awaits You in the Prologue?

  • Progress Up to Level 10: Grow your business from small online orders to city deliveries. Expand your warehouse capacity, manage resources, and learn the basics of Biztopia’s economy.

  • City and Online Deliveries: Use different vehicles to deliver online and city orders, manage logistics, and optimize routes for profit.

  • Warehouse Management: Manage your stocks, expand limited storage, and improve delivery efficiency.

  • R&D Center (Limited Access): Unlock early-level research to increase delivery speed, order probability, and risk management up to level 10.

  • Vehicle System and Fuel Management: Own multiple vehicles, manage fuel levels, and handle inflation-based price changes.

  • Basic Banking and Investments: Deposit earnings in the bank, take small loans, and try short-term investments.

  • Styler Shop: Customize your character with a small clothing and accessory collection to reflect your style.

  • Co-op Multiplayer: Play with friends, share tasks, and grow your city business as a team.

What Awaits You in the Full Version?

  • No Level Cap: Go beyond level 10 and grow your business even further.

  • International Trade Networks: Expand from local deliveries to container-based global trade.

  • Advanced Warehouses and Automation: Build, customize, and automate your logistics systems.

  • Extended Banking and Investments: Manage your financial portfolio with new investment opportunities.

  • New Business Ventures: Explore entirely new sectors and investment areas beyond e-commerce.

  • Full R&D Tree: Over 70 research options for strategy, logistics, and market dominance.

  • Reputation, Tasks, and Global Rankings: Complete challenging missions and rise to the top of Biztopia’s business world.

Note:
The Prologue version focuses on providing early gameplay experience to teach players core systems such as trade, research, teamwork, and logistics. This experience prepares you for the full-scale world of Biztopia.

data.short_description: Welcome to Biztopia: Prologue! Step into the city, start with a small order, build your own trading world, and team up with friends or go solo! An extraordinary journey full of business and opportunities awaits you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
